name: pr-lifecycle
facts: stage is the default branch and carries no protection, so work is pushed to it directly
main is protected with enforce_admins on, so changes reach it only through a pull request
npm run sync rewrites the skills list in .claude-plugin/plugin.json from disk, and npm run validate must exit 0
The required status check on main is the validate workflow job named skills + manifests
An admin reviews every pull request and accepts it or closes it on quality, value, and fit with the collection
Branch protection does not require an approving review yet, so the review is a policy rather than an enforced gate
